punchline: A chapter of the book had to wait fifteen months because its subject sued the author.
thirty_sec: Matthias Rath sold vitamin pills and, according to Ben Goldacre, bought full-page adverts in South Africa calling anti-retroviral drugs poison. Goldacre criticised him in the Guardian, and Rath sued him and the paper for libel. In March 2008 Mr Justice Tugendhat dismissed most of Rath's applications, and in September Rath dropped the case. The defence had cost more than £500,000, and the chapter on Rath appeared only in a later edition of the book.
